推理岗学习路线图
Inference roles learning roadmap
按依赖关系把十一本手册排成一条线：先把语言和模型原理打牢，再学 GPU 编程，然后落到推理系统，用手写 mini-sglang 做作品集，最后准备面试。

The eleven handbooks in dependency order: first a solid grounding in the language and in how models work, then GPU programming, then inference systems, a hand-written mini-sglang as the portfolio project, and finally interview preparation.
四个里程碑：怎么判断自己到哪儿了
Four milestones: how to tell where you are
17 周分成四段，每段末尾有一个可以自检的里程碑。判断标准都是"能不能做出来"，而不是"看没看完"——达不到就把那一段的重点章节和练习再过一遍，不用急着往下走。勾选章节后，下面会显示你在这条路上的位置。

The 17 weeks fall into four phases, each ending with a milestone you can check yourself against. The test is always "can you do it", not "did you read it": if you are not there yet, go through that phase's key chapters and exercises again before moving on. Once you tick chapters off, this shows where you are on the route.
你在这里
You are here
每个里程碑的完整验收清单（含真卡性能门槛、模拟面试评分）在17 周冲刺计划里。
The full checklist for each milestone (including the performance bar on a real GPU and the mock interview scores) is in the 17-week sprint plan.
全景：17 周怎么安排
The big picture: how the 17 weeks are laid out
与17 周冲刺计划逐周对应：每周约 30 小时，精读必学章节，已经熟悉的内容做完章首自测就跳过；作品 A（手写 mini-sglang 上 GPU）从第 6 周开始与学习并行。每个阶段的目标、验收和产出都取自冲刺计划。主要在 Mac 上学习的话，先看学习环境一页，一键装好环境。各手册首页的建议用时按从零精读估算，时间宽裕可以按那个节奏。点击色块跳到对应阶段。

Week by week it matches the 17-week sprint plan: about 30 hours a week, read the core chapters closely, and skip what you already know after the self-test at the top of each chapter; portfolio project A (taking the hand-written mini-sglang to a GPU) runs alongside from week 6. Every phase's goal, checks and deliverables come from the sprint plan. If you mainly study on a Mac, start with the setup page to install everything in one go. The suggested times on each handbook's home page assume careful reading from scratch; follow that pace if you have the time. Click a bar to jump to its phase.
虚线：与主线并行或按需回查的内容——Python 查漏、学 CUDA 和推理系统时回到大模型手册查原理、贯穿中后期的 C++ 与作品 A。

Dashed: work that runs alongside the main line or that you look up when needed: filling Python gaps, going back to the LLM and math books while studying CUDA and inference systems, the C++ that runs through the middle and later weeks, and project A.
